title: ingestion_queue bytes counter uses AcqRel for pre-reserve but Relaxed for depth — inconsistent ordering
description: ingestion_queue.rs try_enqueue: bytes_current uses fetch_add(AcqRel) for the pre-reserve and depth_current uses fetch_add(Relaxed) after try_send succeeds. The Relaxed store to depth_current can become visible to another thread before the bytes_current update, causing current_depth() to reflect a count higher than bytes_current reflects. The is_bytes_overloaded check reads bytes_current with Relaxed, which is fine for advisory, but depth/bytes observations can be inconsistent. For the correctness invariant that depth and bytes stay consistent, both should use the same ordering.
